summary: GFL Environmental filed a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO and CFO certifications. Results show Q3 revenue of $2,155.3 million versus $1,694.2 million, and a net loss from continuing operations of $28.0 million versus prior-year income of $90.4 million; nine-month continuing net loss was $409.8 million. Prior-year comparatives reflect $3,620.8 million of discontinued-operations income tied to divestitures. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are disclosed; this is routine periodic reporting, not a special situation.
